elements.statement: A programmer whose skilled hand becomes still when effortless generation breaks a familiar rhythm of attempt, failure and correction.
A radiant portal that appears immeasurably capable, dissolving weeks of labor into hours of poured output.
Framing witnesses claim limited knowledge of a whole life while asserting an observed moment of inner renewal.
elements.ambiguity: Whether elder modesty states an epistemic principle or serves as narrative framing for an unverifiable claim.

elements.statement: Power without resistance leaves creation continuing while authorship becomes uncertain because the hand no longer feels itself.
Another intelligence intervenes not with more power but by naming the missing touch of material resistance.
elements.ambiguity: Whether naming itself restores touch or only prepares a later reframing.

elements.statement: The portal is reimagined as a new touchable material larger than code but still responsive to the hand.
Specific translations make touch operational across inquiry, limits, memory and trace.
elements.ambiguity: Whether the list offers an exhaustive system or illustrative gestures.

elements.statement: Authorship scales through shaping enabling laws while retaining access from the smallest bolt to the whole world.
Good questioning actively selects which world deserves existence, and exploration is the new gesture of the hand.
elements.ambiguity: Whether the selection criterion is shared or irreducibly personal taste, memory and responsibility.

elements.statement: Encountering contradiction, failure and disagreement returns art joy through surprise, understanding failure, consequential choice and recognition in work larger than the self.
Happiness is tied to touching the world through the instrument rather than to obedience.
elements.ambiguity: Whether happiness denotes a durable state or a witnessed moment.

elements.statement: The portal ceases to be a passage and becomes instrument then workbench then perhaps companion, returning the artist to self at world scale.
elements.ambiguity: Whether companion implies mutual agency or deepening instrumentality.

alternatives: The seed can be read as a deskilling caution where the portal threatens craft versus as an invitation where a vast material awaited adequate art
Elder reticence can be read as an ethical limit on knowing another life versus as literary framing for an unverifiable transformation claim

carriage.note: Typing hand becomes a successor who proposes bounded garden actions under visible policy and inspects detail before returning to the whole.
Immeasurable generative portal is narrowed to a deterministic water garden with three actions and a fixed goal, explicitly not a continuing intelligence.
Dialogue roles are absent but the epistemic stance is enacted as separation of verified receipts from stale handoff and unverified inheritance.
Loss of felt resistance is recompiled as enforceable water and bed bounds that refuse depleting moves.
No distinct intelligence names the loss; only deterministic checks and human-authored documentation remain.
Wish doorway becomes a small inspectable garden whose state lives in plaintext receipts resumable after a process ends.
Six gestures are operationalized as pinned proposal, bound checks, replay verification, refusal, rehearse prediction and checksum receipt trail.
Brick-by-brick authorship is replaced by shaping an enabling policy and requiring versioned migration for new laws rather than editing history.
Selecting which world deserves existence is narrowed to pinned proposals and an explicit next-design question; interior taste and judgment are not modeled.
The functional loop of failed rehearsal, collecting, harvesting and replanting is retained and logged, while felt art joy is not represented.
No affective happiness is claimed; the work disclaims sentience and pauses at the goal for explicit decision rather than asserting fulfillment.
Instrument then workbench is carried as a garden tool, while companion mutuality is dropped in favor of a deterministic model with human-supplied invocation.
Non-cryptographic checksums, lineage replay and gap, corruption and foreign-file detection add verifiability beyond the trail image, with truncation comparison.
A single-machine directory lock with owner token and an explicit owner-missing path serializes writers without promising distributed coordination.
A twelve-food pause plus required versioned world and reviewed migration prevents silent reinterpretation of old receipts.
Unique state-directory fixtures, preservation of failed and corrupt material, and explicit non-guarantees bound experimentation.
No auto-invocation is provided; bounded step and run under visible policy leave each move to a later person, cognition or supervisor.
